leaked_early.details: No pre-deal rumors; acquisition was described as a 'surprise' to the market.

notes: Deal valued at ~$11.2B (including option cash-out) for a clinical-stage HCV company; no CVR. Gilead's 4-step bid escalation from $100 to $137/share followed competitive outreach to 4 parties, with only Gilead remaining at the end.
